purpose: Specify one deterministic direct L to R seam that projects exact EffectProposal preconditions and exact four-valued M2 fact states into paired EligibilityVerdict and M3 insertion deltas without frontier, demand, H, or effect authority.
owned_mechanism: Validate and bind one exact LFixpointResult, LRuleBundle, RDataflowProfile, LRBindingProfile, and LRQueryBatch before any output is produced.
Project each declared query atom through the frozen four-valued truth table and bind exact M2 support derivation identifiers as EligibilityVerdict evidence.
For a non-empty query batch, emit exactly one proposal insertion delta and one verdict insertion delta per proposal; for an empty query batch, emit an empty verdict set and a null command.
excluded_policy_and_authority: New proposals, inferred preconditions, query planning, undeclared atom lookup, rule evaluation beyond the supplied M2 fixpoint, and any rewrite of protocol EffectProposal values
R frontier advancement, demand grants, stabilization, publication, retraction, persistence, clocks, randomness, filesystem, network, environment, subprocess, credentials, models, plugins, and tools

H authorization, EffectIntent creation, dispatch, execution, retries, compensation, reconciliation, receipts, irreversible-effect safety, production readiness, comparative efficacy, engine promotion, and Lakatos progress
binding_invariants: The union of fact_requirements.precondition_id and frontier_precondition_ids equals proposal.preconditions exactly, with no duplicate, omitted, invented, or cross-proposal binding.
Every LRFactRequirement literal is an exact atom declared by the supplied LRuleBundle; undeclared atoms reject as QUERY_ATOM_NOT_DECLARED and no ambient or inferred query is allowed.
Every referenced fact state exists in the exact supplied L materialization and is read without mutation or default synthesis; a missing state rejects as FACT_STATE_NOT_FOUND.
The L fixpoint, rule bundle, R profile, binding profile, and query batch bind exact declared digests and contract, schema, canonicalization, rule-set, and dataflow versions.
Each proposal_id occurs once in a query batch and an exact duplicate or identity collision rejects as DUPLICATE_PROPOSAL.
frontier_precondition_ids are declared preconditions excluded from fact evaluation; the seam neither reads nor advances an R frontier and does not treat them as eligibility evidence.
output_invariants: A proposal is eligible only when every fact requirement is satisfied under its literal polarity; any conflict makes it conflicted with conflict dominating unsatisfied, and otherwise any unsatisfied requirement makes it ineligible.

Each verdict binds the exact proposal_id and rule_set_version, and support_derivation_ids is the canonical union of all evidence consulted across its requirements: positive IDs for a positive TRUE_ONLY or negative TRUE_ONLY requirement, negative IDs for a positive FALSE_ONLY or negative FALSE_ONLY requirement, both positive and negative IDs for BOTH, and none for NEITHER.

Every non-empty accepted projection emits exactly two +1 RValueDelta values per query at one logical_time: the exact supplied EffectProposal under proposal_source_id and the derived EligibilityVerdict under verdict_source_id.
The RApplyDeltaBatch binds the exact R profile digest and dataflow version, contains no -1 delta, and contains no frontier or demand command.
An empty accepted query batch returns verdicts as an empty canonical set and command as null; no empty RApplyDeltaBatch is fabricated.
Validation is atomic: any rejection returns only LRProjectionRejection and no partial verdict, command, delta, or mutated input.
identity_and_digest_rules: Every digest is lowercase sha256:<64-hex> over flrh-cjson/1 canonical bytes of its named complete preimage.
Fact requirements, frontier precondition identifiers, queries, support derivation identifiers, verdicts, and deltas are canonical-byte-sorted sets in accepted and emitted forms.

Query, verdict, value, delivery, R command, and projection identities use their declared M2, M3, protocol, or seam preimages without ambient fields or caller-selected digest substitutions; R value and delivery identities use the exact M3ValuePreimage and M3DeliveryPreimage definitions already frozen by M3.
Canonicalization rejects floats, non-string object keys, invalid Unicode, non-NFC strings, duplicate set members, and integers outside signed 64-bit before hashing.
completion_gate: Contract, manifest, schemas, fixture corpus, success and rejection goldens, and every inherited dependency digest validate under Draft 2020-12 with format checking.

R-LR1 through R-LR6 cover exact precondition binding, four-valued truth mapping, exact support evidence, paired +1 deltas, empty null output, limits, atomic rejection, replay, ambient denial, and semantic mutation sensitivity.

Every frozen result equals an independently implemented oracle after excluding only declared numeric statistics, and clean processes with distinct hash seed, timezone, cwd, and ambient environment reproduce exact canonical bytes.
completion_boundary: Passing this seam measures only the declared direct Python L to R projection slice and frozen corpus. It does not validate new L inference, R frontier or demand mechanics, persistent or distributed runtime behavior, H authority or effects, irreversible-effect safety, production readiness, comparative efficacy, engine promotion, or Lakatos progress.
